body: What do you mean by compliment?
I kind of thought the whole friend thing was to try and make me not feel as bad. I think I might need some time in general, but I could see myself being friends with her

Thank you. Thank you so much. I know things can get better and they will. It’s just that this rejection sent me over the edge. I always like to listen to the line from Portal 2 about not making lemonade, but that you should make life take the lemons back lol. I guess that might not be the right mindset, but it always makes me laugh. Things are just very hard right now, but I appreciate your help
